verdict.rationale: cubic's privacy & security docs say its model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) contractually commit not to train on customer code or metadata passed through their APIs. Organizations can also ask to block AI features entirely for their workspace. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on whether cubic itself trains models on customer code (versus per-workspace learning), a self-serve opt-out control rather than a by-request block, and independent corroboration.
